description: Remarkable websites a project can build on (live maps of planes, ships, weather and earthquakes, open data and statistics, book, map and art archives, space, science): whether there is an official API, whether it needs a key, whether the data can be downloaded, commercial use and embedding with quotes from the official pages, and build ideas. get_resource gives the full card.

category.description: Optional category name, e.g. Live planet, Books and libraries, Museums and art

commercial.description: Only resources whose license allows commercial use

free_api.description: Only resources with a free official API

no_key.description: Only APIs that work without a key

query.description: Words to match, e.g. earthquakes, public domain art, books, satellite

name: find_resources
title: Sites, open data and archives to build on
